0022600225.text: The Warriors (7-3) come in on a seven-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 6th in the West, with a 5-1 home record and a 2-2 road record. The Rockets (7-3) are 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 7th in the West, and they have lost their last two games after a 7-3 run over their last ten. Golden State is missing Gary Payton II, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody, and Will Richard, and Houston is without Clint Capela, Oscar Tshiebwe, and Steven Adams. The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
